title: The square of an infinite cardinal in the ordinary sheaf universes
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. In either chosen universe, let $\kappa$ be an infinite cardinal, meaning $\aleph_0\leq\kappa$. Then $\kappa\cdot\kappa=\kappa$, where the product is cardinal multiplication.
